advancements.royaumedesidees.allegorie_v: Leave Plato's Cave and finally see the light (and be dazzled by it).
advancements.royaumedesidees.racine.desc: Take up, read, and step through the bookshelf portal.
commande.royaumedesidees.structures.a_re: will be placed again when a player comes near
commande.royaumedesidees.structures.sans: The Kingdom dimension is not loaded.
item.royaumedesidees.lanterne_diogene.ci: "I am looking for a man." (Diogenes of Sinope)
item.royaumedesidees.lanterne_diogene.ef: When held: reveals Shadows within 8 blocks.
item.royaumedesidees.poire.citation: Honestly bought. Not as good as the other kind: Augustine noticed it too.
item.royaumedesidees.poire_volee.citatio: "It was not the pear I loved, but the theft." (after the Confessions, II)
item.royaumedesidees.tolle_lege.citation: "Take up and read; take up and read." (Confessions, VIII)
message.royaumedesidees.caverne.enchaine: You are chained facing the wall, like Plato's prisoners. Break your chains.
message.royaumedesidees.caverne.lanterne: By the path, an old lantern was waiting for you. "I am looking for a man," said Diogenes.
message.royaumedesidees.caverne.lumiere: Your eyes, used to the shadows, burn in the daylight.
message.royaumedesidees.caverne.tenebres: Back in the Cave, your sun-filled eyes see nothing but darkness.
message.royaumedesidees.confession.alleg: Your conscience feels lighter. Guilt left: %1$s.
message.royaumedesidees.confession.loin: You need a Confessional to confess. There is one near the Altar, in the centre of the island.
message.royaumedesidees.confession.rien: Augustine wrote thirteen books of them; you really have nothing?
message.royaumedesidees.confession.trop_: Your confession is too long (%1$s characters at most). Augustine needed thirteen books.
Easy: wait %1$s more seconds before your next confession.
message.royaumedesidees.confessionnal.mo: To confess, type /confesse followed by your sin.
message.royaumedesidees.etal.achat: You honestly buy %1$s pears. They look less tasty.
message.royaumedesidees.etal.ecriteau: "One emerald in the box, %1$s pears for you. Or you could just steal them..."
message.royaumedesidees.figuier.voix: A child's voice from the house next door: "Take up and read; take up and read."
message.royaumedesidees.ombre.intouchabl: It is only a shadow: your blow goes straight through.
message.royaumedesidees.ombre.statue: It was only a wooden statue. Diogenes is still looking for a man.
message.royaumedesidees.portail.allume: "Take up and read; take up and read." The portal opens.
message.royaumedesidees.portail.dans_roy: No more reading here: look for the way out.
message.royaumedesidees.portail.incomple: The book stays silent: you need a 4 by 5 bookshelf frame, empty inside, with a lantern against each corner.
